baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus construction links alleged possession of what is absent from human knowledge to the consequence marked by fa: they therefore write.
baseline_models.mechanism: Locative presence turns hidden knowledge into something supposedly held at the opponents' disposal; ordinary writing is then the proposed observable output of that impossible custody. The question tests the source of their certainty, not merely their literacy.

activation_trace.role: Proximity and presence supply the literal custody relation on which the alleged access depends.
What is hidden from sight or knowledge supplies the inaccessible object that their custody claim would have to overcome.
Joining letters into a written text supplies the public product that would supposedly follow from private access.

changed_reading.before: Do they know the unseen and write it down?
changed_reading.after: Is what is absent from human knowledge actually present at their disposal, such that a written account could serve as the impossible downstream proof of that custody?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus nouns and verb permit a sharper causal reading: uncertainty is treated as possessed material and then converted into a binding determination.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of ghayb names doubt, while a branch of writing names prescription, judgment, or decree. The fa can therefore expose an illicit conversion: because they act as though uncertainty were securely with them, they issue determinations from it.

activation_trace.role: Presence at hand turns an unresolved object into something treated as available and settled.
The explicit doubt branch supplies uncertainty rather than a store of positive secret facts.
Inscription as binding decree supplies the act that improperly hardens uncertainty into judgment.

changed_reading.before: Their writing reports hidden facts they somehow know.
changed_reading.after: The question may ridicule a more dangerous move: do they possess uncertainty itself and therefore harden it into binding judgments?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb can precede alphabetic writing at the material level of joining, while ghayb can name roots concealed below a visible surface.
baseline_models.mechanism: Instead of copying a complete hidden text, the subjects may be imagined as possessing concealed substrate and joining selected pieces into an apparent whole. This keeps the act anchored in writing's root image while shifting it from transcription to construction.

activation_trace.role: Presence supplies their alleged possession of the otherwise concealed material.
Hidden tree roots supply a concrete model of an unseen substrate beneath visible effects.
Joining one thing to another supplies the constructive operation by which fragments become an account.

changed_reading.before: Writing passively copies a complete body of unseen information.
changed_reading.after: Writing may actively assemble a total-looking claim from allegedly possessed but concealed material.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening pen and ordered lines establish writing as an authorized act; the opponents later reduce recited signs to false old writings, and the interrogative sequence asks whether they possess a book they study. The focus question then challenges not just information but their capacity to author the missing warrant for their claims.

activation_trace.role: Writing and written text anchor the focus as an act of producing an inspectable account.
The sharpened writing instrument supplies the surah's opening material source of inscription.
The ordered written row supplies a controlled textual product against which later claims can be measured.
The false-tales branch supplies the opponents' dismissive counter-classification of the recited signs.
The written-book branch supplies the hypothetical document that could have authorized their preferences.
Following a book through reading and study supplies the missing verification procedure.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from an opening pen and lines, through the label of old tales, to a hypothetical studied book and finally the focus act of writing.
Repeated interrogative alternatives progressively remove possible textual warrants before the focus question supplies the most extreme one.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring writing language and its sequence; I infer a contest between authorized inscription and a counter-text the opponents would need to author, while the live alternative is a narrower denial of their ability to predict.

changed_reading.before: The question denies that they can transcribe unseen facts.
changed_reading.after: After the imagined studied book fails, the question asks whether they can author from an unseen archive the very warrant their judgments lack.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owners bind themselves by oath, trust the night, whisper their exclusion, and proceed as though measured capacity guarantees the morning. Seeing the reversed result exposes the gap between resolving a future and possessing it. This narrative makes focus writing as decree more concrete: they cannot prescribe an unseen outcome into actuality.

activation_trace.role: Hidden knowledge supplies the future result absent from the planners' view.
Binding prescription supplies the focus act of treating a planned outcome as fixed.
A distributed binding oath supplies the owners' attempt to lock a collective future into place.
Settling into trust supplies the unexamined interval during which their projected future is reversed.
Lowered secret speech supplies the covert coordination by which the owners enact their private forecast.
Planning by measure supplies their confidence that intention and calculation can govern the result.
Actual sight supplies the later evidence that overturns what had only been privately projected.

structural_cues: The garden episode orders intention, oath, sleep, covert movement, claimed capacity, sight, and reversal.
The owners' future-tense resolve is answered by an outcome that occurs outside their awareness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed plan and branches for oath, trust, secrecy, measure, and sight; I infer that focus writing can mean fixing a future by decree, while the alternative is that the episode only illustrates ignorance without activating the writing sense.

changed_reading.before: They might write down a future already known to them.
changed_reading.after: Like the garden owners, they act as though resolve can write the unseen future into force, but the narrated reversal separates private decree from actual outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier promise locates protected, concealed gardens of well-being with their Lord. Repeating the same locative root in the focus but attaching it to the opponents and the unseen creates a custody reversal: genuine held good belongs under divine lordship, whereas their alleged holding of hidden knowledge is interrogated.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from a flat knowledge question to a custody test in which writing is the claimed consequence of possessing what is absent from human knowledge.
The book, study, oath, guarantor, partner, and truth sequence made the focus a forensic endpoint exposing self-authored authority.
The failed garden plan activated writing as an attempted decree of the future rather than a passive transcription of it.
The hidden stepwise process of 68:44-45 reversed agency: the subjects are being determined from where they do not know while claiming to author the hidden.
Compensation, debt, burden, selection, and hostile diagnosis kept ledger, register, and classification readings live beside the textual reading.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact fa-causality repeatedly changed domain without losing its anchors: alleged presence of the hidden could lead to transcription, decree, ledger entry, enrollment, or assembled claim. Context did not disambiguate these into one answer; it made the same impossible custody claim fail textually, legally, temporally, economically, socially, and materially.
remaining_uncertainties: Writing may be literal inscription, binding decree, or enrollment; the context activates all three but does not force one exclusive sense.
The processual claim that the hidden trajectory writes the opponents is a reader-supplied reversal, not an explicit grammatical predicate.
The absent-person, subterranean-root, and release-contract readings are branch-grounded but depend on cross-domain analogy and require explicit qualification.
The repeated interrogative alternatives strongly suggest a cumulative audit, but some may remain parallel objections rather than steps in one legal mechanism.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Writing falsely presented as access to the unseen.** `ع ن د B004` supplies possession/proximity, `غ ي ب B001` what is hidden from sight or knowledge, and `ك ت ب B002` writing. The consequential *fa-* makes their writing depend on having the unseen present with them. I infer authoritative inscription would require access to its hidden referent; the question exposes writing without such access as unsupported production.
2. **A decree imagined from uncertainty.** `غ ي ب B006` permits doubt, while `ك ت ب B003` supplies binding decree. I infer uncertain assumptions are being converted into normative conclusions; the ayah challenges the passage from speculation to prescription.
3. **Hidden roots versus visible text.** `غ ي ب B008` supplies buried tree roots, activated by the garden narrative; `ك ت ب B001` supplies joining parts. I supply a material analogy: visible writing, like visible growth, depends on hidden sources. The ayah asks whether they actually possess that source or only assemble surface marks.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:52 closes with the discourse's actual epistemic function: it is a reminder that makes knowledge available, not writing generated from private possession of hidden reality. No later ayah supplies a stronger source-claim than that universal address.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The absent treated as an object held in custody.** Fixed `عِندَهُم` activates `ع ن د B004` (proximity and presence), while fixed `ٱلْغَيْب` activates `غ ي ب B001` (what is hidden from sight or knowledge). The exposed event in 68:42 and the plainly heard reminder in 68:51-52 supply public alternatives; I infer that the questioned claim collapses hiddenness into private possession, as though proximity granted mastery of the unseen. The contradiction between “with them” and “hidden” is the mechanism being exposed.
2. **Private inscription illicitly converted into decree.** Fixed `يَكْتُبُونَ` activates `ك ت ب B002` (writing) and `ك ت ب B003` (inscribing a binding decree). Exposure in 68:42-43 and the command to wait for the Lord's judgment in 68:48 supply public test and a genuine source of decision; I infer that their writing turns inaccessible knowledge into self-authorized judgment. The ayah challenges not literacy but the unsupported arrow unseen → binding text.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:48 locates judgment with the Lord, while 68:51-52 present a reminder that is actually heard and publicly addressed. Those later ayat expose the unsupported conversion in fixed `يَكْتُبُونَ`: privately claimed unseen knowledge cannot become binding decree (`ك ت ب B003`) merely by inscription.

findings.text: Görünmeyenin kendi yanlarında bulunduğunu varsaymak, gizli olanı özel mülkiyet ve yakınlık nesnesine çeviren temel bir çelişki kurar.

Görünür yazının gizli bir kaynağa dayanması, bahçenin görünür büyümesinin gömülü köklere dayanmasına benzetilebilir; fakat ayet bu maddi benzetmeyi açıkça kurmaz.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Claims Become Durable Through Text, Judgment, and Guarantee
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A claim acquires force when it is assembled into a durable record, interpreted under judgment, and backed by a responsible party.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The polemical questions expose a complete documentary institution: material joining, written decree, study, scope, oath, guarantor, partner, fulfillment, and adjudication.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Joining Material Becomes Writing, Decree, and Register
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Separate pieces are joined like stitched leather, letters are ordered into a record, and the record fixes a decree or enters a name in an official register.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: joining and stitching (`quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`); written record (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); binding decree (`quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`); entry into register or class (`quranic:root_001283:B004/m01`); erased trace (`quranic:root_000470:B001/m01`); repeated study and memorization (`quranic:root_000470:B002/m01`); worn book-like material (`quranic:root_000470:B003/m01`); renewed report (`quranic:root_000299:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Durability has a material history. Joining precedes writing; writing permits decree and registration; study counters the fading of the trace. The claimed book in 68:37 is therefore tested as object, institution, and transmission practice.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Obligation Acquires Weight, Price, and Market Form
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A social or verbal demand becomes tangible when it attaches as debt, is measured as weight, or enters exchange as a price.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The rejected fee is surrounded by a full political economy of wages, debtors, standards, levies, markets, advance payment, charity, and emancipation installments.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Wage Becomes Attaching Debt and Surety
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Compensation is requested for work; if treated as liability, it adheres to debtor and creditor until a guarantor or installment discharges it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: wage or contractual compensation (`quranic:root_000015:B001/m03`); financial charge (`quranic:root_001081:B001/m01`); creditor-debtor attachment (`quranic:root_001081:B002/m01`); lasting punitive liability (`quranic:root_001081:B003/m01`); guarantor (`quranic:root_000633:B003/m02`); manumission contract paid by installments (`quranic:root_001283:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Fee and debt are not synonyms. Wage compensates work, debt binds parties across time, guaranty reallocates default risk, and installments can turn payment into emancipation; 68:46 denies that this apparatus explains rejection.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Covering Establishes the Stakes of Disclosure and Exposure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A cover creates an interior that may protect, hide, or entomb; lifting or losing it changes the occupant’s vulnerability and public status.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Unseen knowledge, armor, grave, grove, fruit-husk, uncovered defect, open hostility, exposed terrace, and abandoned child occupy distinct positions in one cover-removal mechanism.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Pit, Grove, Root, and Grave Make Nested Interiors
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A thing passes from ordinary visibility into a low place, dense growth, underground root, or grave, each providing a different depth and permanence of concealment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: absence from eye and knowledge (`quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`); hidden pit or depression (`quranic:root_001117:B002/m01`); concealing grove (`quranic:root_001117:B003/m01`); hidden root later excavated (`quranic:root_001117:B008/m01`); burial (`quranic:root_001117:B009/m01`); sensory cover (`quranic:root_000266:B001/m04`); burial wrapping (`quranic:root_000266:B009/m02`); hiding-place (`quranic:root_000266:B017/m02`); vast darkness or water that covers (`quranic:root_001307:B002/m01`); fruit-sheath (`quranic:root_001307:B010/m02`); hidden mountain pass (`quranic:root_001307:B013/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:47 `غَيْبُ` [غ ي ب]; 68:51 `كَفَرُ` [ك ف ر] and `مَجْنُونٌ` [ج ن ن].
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Concealment has topology. Pit lowers, grove surrounds, root passes underground, grave seals, and mountain pass hides by terrain; this differentiates ordinary unseen knowledge from physical inaccessibility and burial.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Ground Surface Controls Posture, Footing, and Exposure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Surface composition and elevation determine whether a body can stand, lower itself, move securely, find cover, or remain publicly exposed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Hard and soft stone, low dead earth, bare expanse, slick soil, hoof-protecting gait, mountain-center, hidden grove, floor cushion, and parapetless roof make bodily posture a property of terrain and shelter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Shelter Distinguishes a Protected Interior from an Open Edge
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person moves between grove, hiding-place, floor cushion, bare land, and an unguarded roof, each position supplying or removing a different kind of enclosure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: roof without parapet (`quranic:root_000015:B003/m01`); hiding-place (`quranic:root_000266:B017/m01`); concealing grove (`quranic:root_001117:B003/m01`); cushion cast on the floor for sitting (`quranic:root_001466:B008/m01`); stripped body or land (`quranic:root_001005:B003/m01`); uncovered open ground (`quranic:root_001005:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Cover is spatially graded. Grove and hiding-place obscure the occupant, a cushion supports an interior posture, the bare plain removes enclosure, and a roof without parapet raises the body while leaving its edge unprotected.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Discourse Coordinates Endpoint, Location, and Reference
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Relational and deictic operators place an event at a limit, in a setting, or before an interlocutor, then identify or question the entity under discussion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Endpoint, proximity, accompaniment, vague location, bounded day, demonstrative, relative, interrogative, attention-call, response, copular presence, and formal definition expose the small grammatical operations that stage a claim.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Endpoint, Proximity, and Duration Place the Event
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Discourse fixes movement at a limit, locates something at or with another thing, and bounds the resulting situation by a day or an open duration.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: endpoint and attained limit (`quranic:root_000076:B001/m01`); “at” as proximal location (`quranic:root_000076:B002/m01`); accompaniment and joining (`quranic:root_000076:B003/m01`); vague location resolved by its clause (`quranic:root_000375:B001/m01`); nearness or presence “at” something (`quranic:root_001052:B004/m01`); reaching an endpoint (`quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`); bounded daylight (`quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`); duration of any length (`quranic:root_001700:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:39 `بَٰلِغَةٌ` [ب ل غ] and `يَوْمِ` [ي و م]; 68:42 `يَوْمَ` [ي و م]; 68:44 `حَيْثُ` [ح ي ث]; 68:47 `عِندَهُمُ` [ع ن د]; surface anchors unavailable for root `ء ل ي`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Placement is assembled from distinct relations. A limit answers “how far,” proximity answers “where relative to what,” accompaniment answers “with whom,” and temporal span answers “for how long”; together they turn an unplaced assertion into an event with coordinates.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, belirli görevli biçimin bir nesneyle kullanıldığında sözü dinleyeni onu almaya çağıran bir buyruk olduğunu açıkça belirtir ve bunu benzer buyurucu yapılarla aynı yapı içinde gösterir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu özel işlevi doğru sınırlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca sözü dinleyenin almasını veya tutmasını isteyen görevli biçime bağlıdır; yakınlık bildiren genel kullanıma ya da bağımsız kök anlamına yayılmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin gözlerden saklı kalmasını çekirdek sayarken duyudan ve insan bilgisinden uzak olanı, güneşin gözden kaybolmasını ve kişinin bulunmamasını da aynı alan içinde açıkça toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, birini yokluğunda kötüleme, saklayıcı çukur yer, koruluk, kuşku ve özel adlandırmalarla karıştırılmayan genel görünmezlik ve yokluk anlamıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın genel görünmeme, bulunmama ve bilinmeme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; öteki dallardaki özel yapılara ait anlamları içine almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin gözden veya duyudan saklı kalması, bulunduğu yerde hazır olmaması ya da insanın bilgisi dışında bulunmasıdır. Güneşin gözden çekilmesi ve bir kişinin ortamda bulunmaması bu çekirdeğin gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şey gözle görülmez, duyuyla algılanmaz veya insan tarafından bilinmez durumda kalır.
Bir kişi bulunduğu yerden uzak olduğunda veya hazır bulunmadığında aynı yokluk alanına girer.
Güneşin ufuktan çekilip gözden kaybolması, görünmez hale gelmenin belirgin bir örneğidir.
Birine doğrudan seslenmenin karşısında, onun hazır bulunmadığı durum da bu yokluk üzerinden anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, gözden saklı olmayı duyusal erişimsizliğe, hazır bulunmamaya ve insan bilgisinin dışında kalmaya doğru genişletir; güneşin gözden çekilmesi bu çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

word_morpheme_spans.note: Accepted bridge links preserve independent analysis identities. Several analysis entries may share canonical morphemes. Read their distinct semantic claims; shared morphology alone is not duplication. Legacy aligned_qac_word_ref values are source observations, not QAC joins. Excluded source entries remain available with their explicit qualification.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: Legacy analysis and QAC numbers are separate source namespaces. Use accepted word_morpheme_spans for actual many-to-many joins. The legacy numbering observation is preserved, not used for alignment.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

missing_branch_inventories.reason: no accepted, non-contaminated branch inventory in resource

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

butuncul_okuma.note: no whole-surah reading file exists for this surah

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
